description: Giant Bomb historically offered a free REST encyclopedia API (games, platforms, characters, companies, franchises, and related metadata). After independence from Fandom it rebuilt its stack from scratch; the official API page states wiki data was retained but access mechanisms are not currently available and will change. Games/characters/companies and related APIs are listed as not available while the wiki is rebuilt.
resolution_notes: status: auditor right — official https://giantbomb.com/api lists Games/Characters/Companies/etc. APIs as not available post-Fandom rebuild (→defunct). base_url: auditor right — /api is a notice page, not a live REST root. docs_url: auditor right — /api/documentation is not usable docs; same notice. auth: auditor right — prior api_key/headers not currently usable; no current auth docs. free_tier: auditor right — no accessible free tier while endpoints offline (false). example.request: auditor right — /api/game unavailable. description: auditor right — present-tense “provides” false; rewrote as historical + rebuild. Evidence: https://giantbomb.com/api
